subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: Which reverse-proxy transport-auth modes should OpenClaw mobile setup support as a core connection contract, and should the first approved scope be Basic auth only or include bearer/custom-header metadata now?
rationale: The issue adds credential-bearing setup and transport surface across mobile clients, and the current related PRs show multiple possible scopes rather than a single mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve Basic-first contract
options.body: Standardize a minimal Basic-auth transport-header contract for mobile gateway connections now and track bearer/custom/OIDC as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Approve broader header contract
options.body: Design setup-code and mobile storage for bearer/custom header or cookie support in one pass, accepting larger compatibility and security review scope.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Keep mobile proxy auth unsupported for now and document VPN/tunnel or direct trusted-proxy deployment alternatives.

recommendation.title: Approve Basic-first contract
recommendation.body: Standardize a minimal Basic-auth transport-header contract for mobile gateway connections now and track bearer/custom/OIDC as separate follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses setup-code, auth contracts, and mobile gateway connection behavior where this owner has recent history.
